input.summary: Add affiliate/successor assignment carve-out for Company
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a blanket assignment bar with no M&A carve-out, so we have added Company's right to assign to an affiliate or successor on notice; the consent standard for all other assignments is unchanged.

ops.oldText: Neither party shall assign, transfer, or subcontract this Agreement or any of its obligations hereunder without the other party's express, prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld.
ops.newText: Neither party shall assign, transfer, or subcontract this Agreement or any of its obligations hereunder without the other party's express, prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld; provided that Company may assign this Agreement, without consent and upon written notice to Contractor, to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets, and no change of control of Company shall give Contractor any right to terminate or re-price this Agreement.

input.summary: Extend Contractor Information licence to affiliates and contractors and make it irrevocable and successor-transferable
input.comment: [Playbook] Our licences must reach our affiliates and the contractors acting for us and survive an M&A transaction, so we have added those words and "irrevocable" to the existing perpetual grant; scope is otherwise unchanged.

ops.oldText: a royalty-free, non- exclusive perpetual license (including the right to grant a sublicense)
ops.newText: a royalty-free, non-exclusive, perpetual and irrevocable license, extending to Company's affiliates and to contractors acting on Company's behalf and transferable to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of Company's assets (including the right to grant a sublicense),
